 ----
 
+To report SIMD timing/throughput:
+
+----
+warp dump simd --lang json --enhanced --perf path/to/file.json
+----
+
 The enhanced scan is also respected in `dump full` when the same flag is used.

+      private def self.scan_to_line_end(bytes : Bytes, start : Int32) : Int32
+        len = bytes.size
+        return len if start >= len
+        backend = Warp::Backend.current
+        ptr = bytes.to_unsafe
+        i = start
+        while i < len
+          block_len = len - i
+          block_len = 64 if block_len > 64
+          mask = backend.newline_mask(ptr + i, block_len)
+          if mask != 0
+            return i + mask.trailing_zeros_count
+          end
+          i += 64
+        end
+        len
+      end
